newsitem.title: USA: Creative BioMolecules closes Biogen deal.
newsitem.headline: Creative BioMolecules closes Biogen deal.

text.p: Creative BioMolecules on Monday said it completed a collaborative agreement with Biogen Inc to develop therapeutics for treating renal disorders, and received an initial payment of $28 million.
The payment comprised a $10 million technology-access fee and the purchase of $18 million in equity at $11.67 per share, the company said.
The alliance is intended to advance the development of Creative's morphogenic protein for the treatment of acute and chronic renal failure, the company said.
Biogen's investment could total over $122.5 million in equity, fees, research support, development milestones and credit, Creative said.
Under the terms of the deal, Biogen would fund the renal program, with responsibility for preclinical and clinical development of the protein OP-1 and commercial manufacturing.
Biogen received exclusive worldwide rights to market and sell OP-1 products developed through the collaboration, Creative said.
